title: Code for Image embeddings add limited predictive value to metadata in two NFT collections
description: Frozen source code and aggregate outputs for the September 2026 BAYC/MAYC revision experiments: eight TF-IDF metadata regressors, seven image encoders crossed with eight regressors, TF-IDF early fusion, conditional late fusion over eleven weights, paired uncertainty and four supplemental analyses. Includes source hashes, configurations, execution records, public validation tests, and an aggregate table exporter. Replaces the active v3.3.6.4 code tree. Raw transaction data, NFT images, embeddings, fitted models and row-level predictions are excluded; full numerical refitting requires the documented author-supplied inputs. Public tests do not constitute an independent full-data replication.
